meadow.line: Drip from black-wired fears in the meadow
stanza: Drip from black-wired fears in the meadow
With an anger that is thin and turns to sorrow
King of all, hear me call
I can' t remember the faces I've seen

meadow.line: Little while later the Pharisees dragged a comb through the meadow
stanza: The meadowlark and the chim-choo-ree and the sparrow
Set to the sky in a flying spree, for the sport of the pharaoh
Little while later the Pharisees dragged a comb through the meadow
Do you remember what they called up to you and me, in our window?

meadow.line: From the magnolia trees in the meadow
stanza: From the magnolia trees in the meadow
